nodes.summary: The average Rademacher norm is at most `(∑ᵢ ‖xᵢ‖²)^{1/2}` (Cauchy–Schwarz for the finite average, plus the exact second moment).
nodes.title: Bound on the average Rademacher norm

nodes.summary: For unit vectors, the average squared Rademacher sum equals `n`.
nodes.title: Average squared Rademacher sum of unit vectors

nodes.summary: The average (uniform over sign vectors) of `‖∑ᵢ εᵢ • xᵢ‖²` is exactly `∑ᵢ ‖xᵢ‖²`.
nodes.title: Average squared norm of a Rademacher sum

nodes.summary: Number of sign vectors: `Fin n → Bool` has `2 ^ n` elements.
nodes.title: Number of sign vectors of length n

nodes.summary: Let $X$ be a real Banach space, $n$ a natural number and $f : \{-1, 1\}^n \to X$. For $j \in \{1, \dots, n\}$ and $\varepsilon = (\varepsilon_1, \dots, \varepsilon_n) \in \{-1, 1\}^n$, the discrete partial derivative of $f$ in direction $j$ at $\varepsilon$ is
nodes.title: Discrete partial derivative on the Rademacher cube

nodes.summary: Let $X$ be a real Banach space, $C \in [0, \infty]$ and $p$ a real number. We say that $X$ has Enflo type $p$ with constant $C$ if for every $n \ge 1$ and every function $f : \{-1, 1\}^n \to X$,
nodes.title: Enflo type

nodes.summary: Let $X$ be a real Banach space, $C \in [0, \infty]$ and $p$ a real number. We say that $X$ has Rademacher type $p$ with constant $C$ if for every $n \ge 1$ and all $x_1, \dots, x_n \in X$,
nodes.title: Rademacher type

nodes.summary: Every Rademacher sign has norm `1`.
nodes.title: Rademacher signs have norm one

nodes.summary: Rademacher cotype 2 with constant `1`: `∑ᵢ ‖xᵢ‖²` is at most the average of the squared Rademacher sums.
nodes.title: Hilbert spaces have Rademacher cotype 2

nodes.summary: The Rademacher distribution is the measure on $\{-1, 1\}$, viewed as a subset of $\mathbb{Z}$, that gives mass $1/2$ to each of $1$ and $-1$.
nodes.title: Rademacher distribution

nodes.summary: For an index type $\iota$, this is the product over $\iota$ of copies of the Rademacher distribution: the joint law of a family $(\varepsilon_i)_{i \in \iota}$ of independent Rademacher random variables, as a measure on the functions $\iota \to \{-1, 1\}$.
nodes.title: Product Rademacher distribution

nodes.summary: The sign is `-1` on a `false` coordinate.
nodes.title: Rademacher sign on a false coordinate is minus one

nodes.summary: The sign is `1` on a `true` coordinate.
nodes.title: Rademacher sign on a true coordinate is one

nodes.summary: The Rademacher sign attached to a coordinate: `1` for `true`, `-1` for `false`.
nodes.title: Rademacher sign of a coordinate

nodes.summary: Rademacher type 2 with constant `1`: the average of the squared Rademacher sums is at most `∑ᵢ ‖xᵢ‖²`.
nodes.title: Hilbert spaces have Rademacher type 2

nodes.summary: Square-root form of the exact second moment.
nodes.title: Square-root form of the Rademacher second moment

nodes.summary: Exact second moment of a Rademacher sum in a Hilbert space: the sum over all sign vectors of `‖∑ᵢ εᵢ • xᵢ‖²` equals `2 ^ n * ∑ᵢ ‖xᵢ‖²`. Cross terms cancel: the induction step pairs the two values of the last sign and applies the parallelogram law.
nodes.title: Second moment of a Rademacher sum in a Hilbert space

nodes.summary: Scalar real form: the second moment of `∑ᵢ ±aᵢ` over all sign choices is `2 ^ n * ∑ᵢ aᵢ²`.
nodes.title: Second moment of a real Rademacher sum

nodes.summary: For a real Banach space $X$ and a real number $p$, $T^E_p(X)$ is the infimum in $[0, \infty]$ of all $C \in [0, \infty]$ such that $X$ has Enflo type $p$ with constant $C$.
nodes.title: Enflo type constant

nodes.summary: For every real Banach space $X$ and every real number $p$ with $1 \le p \le 2$, the Rademacher type constant and the Enflo type constant of $X$ satisfy $T^R_p(X) \le T^E_p(X) \le \frac{\pi}{\sqrt{2}}\, T^R_p(X)$.
nodes.title: Comparison of Rademacher and Enflo type constants

nodes.summary: For a real Banach space $X$ and a real number $p$, $T^R_p(X)$ is the infimum in $[0, \infty]$ of all $C \in [0, \infty]$ such that $X$ has Rademacher type $p$ with constant $C$.
nodes.title: Rademacher type constant

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
